name: Creature Model Race
description: Race-dependent model overrides: when a player of a matching race sees a creature with this display id, it is replaced either by another model (modelid_racial) or by the model of another creature entry. Used e.g. for mounts and totems that look different per race.

fields.name: Model Id
fields.help: Base display id being replaced (must exist in creature_model_info).

fields.name: Race Mask
fields.help: Mask of player races this override applies to.

fields.name: Creature Entry
fields.help: Replacement source: use the model of this creature_template entry. Mutually exclusive with Model Id Racial.

fields.name: Model Id Racial
fields.help: Replacement display id (must exist in creature_model_info). Ignored if Creature Entry is set.
